AddedToothSlot.description: A slot added at the end of a row.

Cowlick.description: A cowlick: a small swirl or flip at a point, as a fringe flicking up at the hairline.

around.description: Degrees round the head from the front, positive toward the character's right.

up.description: Degrees up the head from level.

radius.description: How far across the head it reaches, in degrees.

strength.description: How strongly it rules the hair over it, 0 not at all to 2.

turn.description: 0 flips the hair back against the flow; 1 swirls it clockwise round the point seen from outside, -1 the other way.

lift.description: Degrees the locks over it lift off the head, most at its middle.

EyeIrisShade.description: The iris shaded in cel tones: a darker top melting into the pupil, a lighter crescent along its bottom and a darker rim; each off at 0.

upper.description: How far down the darker top reaches, a share of the iris's height, where there is no crescent; with one it reaches down to the crescent. 0 none.

upperSlot.description: The darker top's palette slot; left out, the iris's colour taken darken of the way to the pupil's.

darken.description: How far the darker top's colour goes from the iris's toward the pupil's, when it names no slot.

soft.description: How soft the darker top's lower edge is, a share of the iris's half height: 0 a hard cel edge.

lower.description: How far up the lighter crescent along the iris's bottom reaches at its middle, a share of the iris's height; it thins to nothing below the middle. 0 none.

lowerSlot.description: The crescent's palette slot; left out, the iris's colour taken lighten of the way to the white's.

lighten.description: How far the crescent's colour goes from the iris's toward the white's, when it names no slot.

rim.description: The width of a darker ring round the iris's edge, a share of its half width. 0 none.

rimSlot.description: The ring's palette slot; the darker top's colour when left out.

EyeLashClumps.description: Lashes as tapering strokes growing out of the upper lid's outer part, curving out and up, in the lid mass's slot, in place of the lash flicks.

length.description: The outermost lash's length, a share of the opening's height: its curve runs about twice that to its tip. Each further one is a little shorter.

spread.description: How much of the upper lid their roots spread over, from where it turns down to the back corner.

width.description: Each lash's thickness either side at its root, a share of the opening's height; it tapers to a fine point. Small and spread wide reads as a few separate lashes.

EyeLidMark.description: A mark on the upper lid, a liner wing or one piece of a pattern: a stroke from a root on the lid tapering to a point, moving with the lid as it closes and kept off the open eye.

along.description: Where its root sits along the lid: -1 the back corner, 1 the front, beyond them past the corners.

above.description: How far above the lash line its root sits, in the opening's heights.

out.description: How far its tip runs toward the back corner from its root, in the opening's half widths; below 0 toward the front.

up.description: How far its tip rises above its root, in the opening's heights.

width.description: Its thickness either side at its root, in the opening's heights; it tapers to a point, a round dot where it reaches nowhere.

bend.description: How much it runs out first and lifts at its tip: 0 straight, 1 a curve.

slot.description: Its palette slot; the look's ink when left out.

EyeLidMass.description: The lid drawn as a tapered mass of ink in place of the even lid line; off while weight is 0. Lengths are shares of the opening.

weight.description: The upper lid's thickness at its heaviest, from its middle to its back corner, a share of the opening's height; 0 draws no mass and keeps the lid line.

inner.description: The upper lid's thickness at its front corner, a share of its heaviest.

flick.description: How far the mass runs on past the back corner, tapering to a point, a share of the opening's half width.

flickLift.description: How far the flick's tip rises above the back corner, a share of the opening's height; below 0 it droops.

lower.description: The lower lid's thickness at the back corner, a share of the upper's heaviest: 0 leaves the lower lid open, 1 as heavy as the upper.

lowerExtent.description: How much of the lower lid is drawn, from the back corner inward, thinning to nothing at its end: 1 the whole lower lid.

slot.description: The mass's palette slot; the look's ink when left out.

EyeLidShadow.description: A shadow band on the white under the upper lid, following its curve and thinning toward the corners; off while depth is 0.

depth.description: How deep the band reaches under the upper lid's middle, a share of the opening's height: about 0.15 to 0.2 hugs the lid.

slot.description: The band's palette slot; left out, the white's colour taken share of the way to a cool grey lilac.

share.description: How far the band's colour goes from the white's toward a cool grey lilac, when it names no slot.

EyeLids.description: How an eye's lids meet when closed and how the upper lid is painted: its own colour, a fade up from the lash line and marks that move with it. Lengths are shares of the opening's height.

closedAt.description: Where the closed lids meet at the opening's middle, in its heights up from the middle: 1 the open upper lid's top, -lowerLid the lower lid's bottom.

closedBend.description: How far the closed line's middle stands above a straight line through its ends, in heights: above 0 it arches up as a happy closed eye does, below 0 it sags, 0 straight.

closedTilt.description: Degrees the closed line turns, its front end up.

slot.description: The upper lid's own colour, an eyeshadow or a darker lid, shown where it covers the opening and, with above, over the skin above it; left out, the lid takes the colour of the face's painted area the eye sits in, the skin where none is, and fade and above do nothing.

fadeTo.description: The colour the lid's own colour fades into going up from the lash line; left out, it fades into the skin.

fade.description: How far up from the lash line the lid's colour fades out, in heights, fading toward the corners too; 0 an even colour.

above.description: How far the lid's colour reaches over the skin above the open lid at its middle, thinning to the corners, in heights; 0 only where the lid covers the opening.

marks.description: Marks painted on the upper lid, a liner wing or a pattern, each moving with the lid as it closes.

EyeLook.description: How a painted eye looks. Lengths are shares of the head's own coordinates at the eye's middle: across (width, irisSize, irisForward) of the one that runs toward the face's front, down (height, irisUp, browRaise) of the one that runs down it. On an upright head (head-round) across is v, once round the head at the eye, and down is u, the head's length from chin to crown, so a unit across spans about 2.2 times a unit down; on a head resting forward (head, head-bird) across is u, along the head, and down is v, once round it. face-and-clothes.md gives both in body units for each head template.

width.description: Half the opening's width, from its middle to each corner, in units across.

height.description: How far the upper lid rises above the opening's middle, in units down.

lowerLid.description: How far the lower lid reaches below the middle, a share of height: 0 a flat lower edge, 1 as deep as the top.

frontNarrowing.description: How much the opening narrows toward its back corner and widens toward its front, a share of its height: 0 an even almond.

topFlatness.description: How flat the upper lid runs, closing steeply at the corners: 0 the lower lid's round curve, 1 nearly straight, so with frontNarrowing or openingTilt it runs slanted.

outerCorner.description: How sharp the back corner is where the lids meet: 0 round, 1 a point.

tilt.description: Degrees the whole eye turns in its plane about its middle, its front end up.

openingTilt.description: Degrees the opening alone turns about its middle, its front end up, before tilt; the iris stays level.

lookOut.description: Degrees the eye's facing turns outward, away from the body's middle plane.

irisSize.description: Half the iris's width, in units across.

irisRatio.description: The iris's half height as a share of irisSize, read in units down: its height is irisSize times irisRatio units down. A round iris on an undrawn head-round takes about 2.2, on a head resting forward about 0.4.

irisForward.description: How far the iris's middle sits toward the front corner from the opening's middle, in units across.

irisUp.description: How far the iris's middle sits up from the opening's middle, in units down.

pupilSize.description: The pupil's size, a share of the iris's.

slit.description: Whether the pupil is an upright slit, a fifth of the iris's width, in place of a round one.

highlightSize.description: The highlight's size, a share of the iris's.

highlightForward.description: How far the highlight's middle sits toward the front from the iris's middle, a share of irisSize.

highlightUp.description: How far the highlight's middle sits up from the iris's middle, a share of the iris's half height.

lid.description: Whether a lid line is inked round the opening.

lashes.description: How many lash flicks rise from the upper lid: 0 none, 1 at the back corner, 2 and 3 spread forward along the lid from there; none while lash clumps are drawn.

brow.description: Whether a brow is inked over the opening.

browRaise.description: How far the brow rises above its place over the opening, in units down (about 2 heights above the middle).

browTilt.description: Degrees the brow turns about its middle, its front end up.

browWidth.description: The brow's thickness, a multiple of the line weight, thinning toward its ends above 1: 1 an ink line, 3 a thick brow.

white.description: The white's palette slot; none fills no white.

ink.description: The lines' palette slot; the ink's when left out.

lidMass.description: The lid drawn as a tapered mass of ink with a flick past the back corner and a lighter lower lid, in place of the even lid line.

lashClumps.description: Lashes as thick curved wedges growing out of the upper lid near the back corner, in place of the lash flicks.

irisShade.description: The iris in cel tones: a darker top, a lighter crescent along its bottom and a darker rim.

lidShadow.description: A shadow band on the white under the upper lid.

lids.description: How the lids meet when closed, and the upper lid's own colour, fade and marks.

over.description: Drawn marks of this role that draw over the lips, open or closed, the lip ink breaking under them: a tongue out, or a drawn tooth. Teeth and tongue only; the teeth's own slots carry their own over flag.

Hairline.description: Where a short-hair shell's hairline runs round the head, in degrees up the head from level, the same on both sides.

front.description: Degrees up the head where it crosses the middle of the forehead.

temples.description: Degrees up the head at its corners above the outer brows: above front recedes them, below rounds them.

sideburns.description: Degrees up the head at the foot of the sideburns, in front of the ears.

ears.description: Degrees up the head over the ears.

nape.description: Degrees up the head at the middle of the nape.

Hide.description: The part is not built while the garment is worn.

JawTeeth.description: What a mouth changes of one jaw of its preset; each left out keeps the preset's.

level.description: The jaw's level in place of the preset's.

added.description: Slots added at the end of a row.

slots.description: Changes to single slots, by row and slot index, counting the preset's slots, then added ones; rows count the preset's, then added ones.

KeyMove.description: How a key moves one thing on a head, in the head's own directions as seen with the camera on the head's left; Squash mirrors it for the camera on the right.

feature.description: What it moves by name on each head: muzzle (the head's muzzle run, or the part on its muzzle socket such as a beak), ears (the parts on its ear sockets) or nose (its nose piece or the part on its nose socket). Give this or part.

part.description: The part it moves, with everything on it. Give this or feature.

run.description: One run or piece of the part by name, such as muzzle or nose, in place of the whole part.

forward.description: How far it moves along the head's facing, a share of the head's length.

up.description: How far it moves up the head, a share of the head's length.

left.description: How far it moves toward the head's left, which is toward the camera in a keyed view, a share of the head's length.

yaw.description: Degrees it turns about the head's up through its root, its front toward the head's left.

pitch.description: Degrees it turns about the head's left through its root, its front up.

roll.description: Degrees it turns about the head's facing through its root, its top toward the head's left.

twist.description: Degrees it turns about its own length through its root, its front toward the head's left: an ear opening toward the camera.

scale.description: How much larger it is, about its root.

width.description: How much wider it is across the head, from left to right, about its root.

height.description: How much taller it is along the head's up, about its root.

depth.description: How much deeper it is along the head's facing, about its root.

area.description: One of the part's areas by name, such as chin or cheeks: the move then shapes only that area, eased out past its edge, on the one surface.

push.description: How far its surface swells out along its normals, a share of the head's length; negative sinks it.

nearPush.description: How far the half of its surface on the camera's side swells out along its normals, a share of the head's length: the near cheek filling out.

LockOverride.description: One lock of a group set by hand, by its index: each value given replaces the group's for that lock alone.

index.description: The lock, by its place in the group from 0.

width.description: Its width at the root, in body units.

thickness.description: Its thickness at the root, in body units.

curl.description: How many turns it curls, toward its underside; negative the other way.

wave.description: How far it waves sideways, a share of its width.

twist.description: How far it turns about itself over its length, in degrees.

rise.description: Degrees its outer part lifts off the head, where it lies along the head from its root: 0 lies flat all along, 90 stands its end straight out. A tied lock leaves its tie at this angle.

sweep.description: How far it sweeps sideways as it grows, -1 to 1: positive toward the character's right.

fall.description: How far it falls toward the ground along its length, 0 none to 1 hanging.

lie.description: How much of its length lies along the head before it lifts off by its rise, 0.05 to 0.95: low stands it out from near its root, a spike; 0.55 when left out.

around.description: Degrees its root moves round the head from where its group lays it, positive toward the character's right.

up.description: Degrees its root moves up the head from where its group lays it.

guide.description: Its guide curve: a few points from its root, in place of the curve its group grows it along.

bones.description: How many bones its chain holds, 3 to 6; by its length when left out.

physics.description: How it moves, in place of its group's.

LockPhysics.description: How a lock moves once physics drives it. Nothing moves yet; these are kept with the character for a solver.

stiffness.description: How firmly it keeps its rest shape, 0 limp to 1 rigid.

damping.description: How quickly its swing dies, 0 never to 1 at once.

weight.description: How heavy it is, 1 a lock of its size.

gravity.description: How much gravity pulls it, 1 fully.

wind.description: How much wind moves it, 1 fully.

angleLimit.description: How far each bone may turn from its rest, in degrees.

neighbours.description: How firmly it is tied to the locks either side of it in its group, 0 untied to 1 moving as one.

LockPoint.description: A point of a lock's guide curve: [x, y, z] from its root, in body units, x forward, y up, z the character's right.

LockTrim.description: A plane the group's lock tips are cut to: a blunt bob's hem, blunt bangs, a flat top.

level.description: How high the cut lies above the skull's middle, a share of the head's reach from its middle: negative below it, toward the jaw; about 1.1 over the top of the head.

tilt.description: Degrees the cut tilts about the head's side to side: positive stands its front higher, a bob longer at the back.

blunt.description: Whether a cut lock ends square, as wide as it was where it was cut; a lock not cut keeps its own tip.

open.description: How far the mouth opens: 0 closed, 1 open. Parts the lips on the head's surface: the inner, tongue and teeth roles show between the upper lip and a lower lip below it. On a beak's seam it drops the lower beak on its jaw instead.

wide.description: Draws the corners out (1) or in (-1).

round.description: Puckers the mouth to a narrow, round opening.

smile.description: Lifts the corners (1) or drops them (-1); a mood a spoken shape's own smile adds to.

upperLip.description: Raises the upper lip off the upper teeth.

lowerLip.description: Tucks the lower lip up under the upper teeth (1, as for F and V) or presses the lips together (-1, as for M, B and P).

tongue.description: Lifts the tongue to the upper teeth by 0.5, then out past the lower lip by 1, as for a blep.

expressionBlend.description: 0 shows the group's own marks, 1 the shown expression's.

MarkFlight.description: A place a floating mark passes through, in body units from its root, in the surface's own directions there.

along.description: Along the surface the way the part's u grows: on a part resting up, toward its far end; negative back toward its socket.

across.description: Across the surface the way the part's v grows, square to along; on a mirrored copy, the other way.

out.description: Out of the surface along its normal at the root; negative sinks into the part.

style.description: The mouth style the group talks in, by preset name (lips, painted, short-muzzle, long-muzzle, beak, wide-jaw, minimal); none takes its head template's.

shapes.description: The spoken shapes this mouth changes from its style's, by name: each value set here replaces the style's.

teeth.description: The mouth's teeth: a preset, by default its style's, and only what this mouth changes of it.

tongueLevel.description: How much tongue the mouth draws: none, or flat (its tongue marks, or a plain tongue where the tongue role has a fill and no mark).

MouthShapeValues.description: A spoken shape's controls; each left out takes the style's value, or 0 in a style.

smile.description: Corners up or down, added to the mouth's own smile.

upperLip.description: Raises the upper lip to show the upper teeth.

lowerLip.description: Tucks under the teeth (1) or presses (-1).

tongue.description: Lifts the tongue to the teeth, then out past the lip.

MouthTeeth.description: A mouth's teeth: a preset by name and what this mouth changes of each jaw.

preset.description: The teeth preset by name (templates/teeth/<name>.teeth.json); none takes the mouth style's.

upper.description: What this mouth changes of the upper jaw.

lower.description: What this mouth changes of the lower jaw.

Recipe.description: A Squash character described as parts, outlines, colours, face, clothes and poses; built into a character file by sending the document commands it stands for.

id.description: The character's id, also the name of the files a build writes.

name.description: The character's name as the app shows it.

plan.description: The body plan the character starts on: blank, biped, bird, canine-quadruped or fish.

planVersion.description: The plan's version; the newest shipped when left out.

palette.description: Named colours, in order. Every colour the recipe uses is a slot named here.

figure.description: The body drawn as a figure outline that the tube parts giving no profiles are fitted to.

parts.description: The parts, each after the part it sits on. A garment's own parts (shades, a heel, a buckle) name their garment.

membranes.description: Thin sheets of skin spanned between parts, such as a patagium or a wing membrane.

hair.description: Hair made of locks, one entry a head: a preset hairstyle, its groups changed or added to, over an inner mass.

expressions.description: Named expressions: joint angles of the face's parts, as ears back or a dropped jaw, and how far each opens a mouth. The build renders each one's face close-up.

displayPose.description: The pose the character is saved and shown in, over the rest it is built in: a biped's arms brought down from A-pose.

poses.description: Named poses the build renders besides the display pose; not saved in the character.

keys.description: Pose keys: the body's shape corrected in a pose, each blended in by joint angle as a pose nears it and gone at the rest.

targets.description: Proportions the built character is checked against, read off a reference: measure.txt flags each one the build is off by more than its tolerance.

creases.description: Creases and wrinkles: ink and a shade band on the inner side of each bending joint, deepening with its bend, on the body and on cloth, and wrinkles and folds where cloth bunches and hangs. On at their defaults when left out; skin 0 and cloth 0 turn them off.

shading.description: How the character is shaded: flat or two-tone, how much darker its far side is, and where its light comes from. Two-tone renders read the far side and the light. As the defaults when left out.

viewKeys.description: Head cheats that follow the camera: the face style, how far the face follows the camera, and keys per view moving the muzzle, ears, nose, any part or the head's shape. Every head's defaults when left out.

RecipeArea.description: One named area of a garment's cloth, as a row of Dress's areas: the cells its strokes paint, in its own colour.

id.description: Unique within the garment, as area-1.

name.description: Its name in Dress; blank when left out.

color.description: Its palette slot, as a red collar on a blue tee; the garment's color when left out.

gather.description: A ribbed band, as a cuff or a sweater's hem: the ease, in body units, the area pulls its cloth in to, eased in over two rows either side; the cloth stands off as the rest does when left out.

fold.description: Cloth turned back over the garment at its hem, as a rolled cuff, a rolled jeans hem or a turtleneck's fold-over: how far, in body units, the area stands out over the cloth beside it, its far edge inked and its color the cloth's back face; lies flat when left out.

opacity.description: Sheer cloth, as stockings, tights or a chiffon layer: how much of the skin under it the cloth hides where it faces the viewer, 0 to 1, times its slot's own opacity; it hides more as it turns away, so it darkens toward the silhouette. The skin's colour, shading and ink show through, tinted by the cloth. Whole when left out.

net.description: A net of thin threads whose holes show the skin, as fishnets or a lace-style mesh, finer than a cell; plain cloth when left out.

paint.description: The strokes that paint it, laid in order: a stroke paints cells into this area and takes them from every other; unpaint takes them from every area.

RecipeCover.description: The garment over one part: the cells of the part's chart its box holds. u runs along the part, past 1 to run on past its end or below 0 before its start; v round it, a span under 1 leaving an opening.

from.description: Where along the part it starts.

to.description: Where along the part it ends.

fromV.description: Where round the part it starts; below 0 to cross v 0.

toV.description: Where round the part it ends.

ease.description: How far it stands off the part where no outline takes it further, when the garment has no fit.

outlines.description: Side and Top outlines along the part's own x where the cloth stands off further, as a skirt's flare.

RecipeCreases.description: How strongly the character creases and wrinkles, each 0 (off) to 2, 1 when left out.

skin.description: Joint creases on the body's skin: a short ink line and a shade band on the inner side of each bending joint (elbow, knee, hip, shoulder, neck, wrist, ankle, waist), faint at rest where a sheet draws one and deepening and lengthening with the bend.

cloth.description: Every garment's creases, wrinkles and drape, times each garment's own creases, wrinkles and drape.

rest.description: How much of a joint's crease shows at rest, as a share of a full bend's, 0 to 1.

joints.description: Joint angles, each naming its part and joint; a mirrored part names each side's id.

open.description: How far it opens mouth groups, by group id, 0 closed to 1 open, in place of each group's own controls.open: parts the lips on any head, with or without a jaw.

RecipeEye.description: A painted eye on a head. Place it by u and v, or by face [x, y] seen from straight ahead (x to the character's left).

on.description: The head it is painted on.

patch.description: The patch u and v lie on.

u.description: Where along the head its middle sits.

v.description: Where round the head its middle sits.

face.description: Its middle as [x, y] on the face seen from straight ahead, in place of u and v.

look.description: How it looks: opening, iris, pupil, highlight, lid, lashes, brow, and their palette slots (white, iris, pupil, highlight, ink).

front.description: How it looks when the head is seen from the front; the look alone when left out.

fromFront.description: How far from its look to the front look a front view goes, 0 to 1.

gazeForward.description: Gaze toward the head's front, a share of the opening's half width.

gazeUp.description: Gaze up, a share of the opening's half height.

mirrored.description: Whether it is painted again on the other side of the head.

flat.description: Whether it lies flat across the face, a decal projected from the way the head faces (turned out by the look's lookOut), in place of following the head's curve from the surface's normal at its middle. Flat keeps a large eye on a small, round head reading as drawn from the front.

upperClose.description: How far the upper lid stands down from open (0) to the look's closed line (1).

lowerRise.description: How far the lower lid stands up from open (0) to the look's closed line (1).

RecipeFigure.description: The body drawn as a figure outline, front and side, which the tube parts that give no profiles are fitted to: their widths, the blend where each joins its parent, and where each limb's root sits. Head, hands and feet are left out: the strokes stop at the chin, the wrists and the ankles.

rootHeight.description: How high above the ground the outline stands on the root part's origin sits, in body units: its strokes' y is height above that ground.

front.description: The front view: the character's left half, x from the body's middle toward its left, y up from the ground. Each stroke runs with the figure on its right.

side.description: The side view from the character's left: x forward from the body's middle, y up from the ground. Each stroke runs with the figure on its right.

pose.description: The pose the outline is drawn in, over the rest: each limb is read in its own bones as this pose shows them. The display pose when left out; [] for a figure drawn at rest.

rounds.description: Rounds of correction read off the built body's own silhouette, each a field evaluation: where the joined body lies off the outline, the parts' widths are moved by a share of it. 3 when left out; 0 builds the plain fit.

RecipeFigureStroke.description: One open stretch of the outline: a smooth curve through a few places, sharp at its corners, or its Bézier points, running with the figure on its right.

id.description: Its name, for messages and the misses a build marks.

through.description: Places the stroke passes through, [x, y] each: few, as drawn.

corners.description: Indices into through that are sharp corners, as an armpit drawn tight.

bezier.description: The Bézier points [x, y] themselves: a start point, then two handles and an end point per segment (3n + 1 points). In place of through.

mirrored.description: Whether an end lying on the body's middle (x 0) runs on into its mirror image, so it crosses the middle level, as the crotch does.

RecipeFur.description: Fur on a part: how its strokes show and patches of stroke roots.

patches.description: Patches of stroke roots laid in staggered rows.

RecipeFurPatch.description: A patch of fur stroke roots in staggered rows, each root a fur mark named <name>-<row>-<column>.

rows.description: How many rows along the part.

columns.description: How many roots round it in each row.

v.description: [from, to] round the part; [0, 1] all round.

RecipeGarment.description: A garment: cloth painted on the body as named areas of cells, as Dress paints it, or given as covers (a box of cells each), standing off the body by its fit. With areas, the parts it covers, the parts that come out through it, the small parts tucked inside it and the inked seams are all read from the painted cells, as Dress writes them.

slot.description: The wardrobe slot it goes in.

layer.description: Counted out from the skin: under a waistband 1, a waistband 2, over both 3.

fit.description: How far it stands off the body, in body units, 0 or more: about 0.005 skin-tight, 0.01 fitted, 0.02 to 0.03 loose on a person-sized body; each cover's own ease when left out.

partFits.description: A fit for one covered part (a pair by its left side), over the garment's.

inkWeight.description: The weight of its silhouette and inked edges as a share of the skin's line weight, 0 to 2; thinner than skin when left out, so cloth reads as cloth and not as a second body.

hemRoll.description: How far its hems, neck openings and cuffs roll out past the cloth, in body units, 0 to 0.03: a cuff or a rolled hem that reads as cloth with a thickness. Every hem stands a little off the skin whatever this is.

creases.description: How strongly it creases on the inner side of each bending joint it covers, with ink, a shade band and a small fold, 0 to 2, times the character's cloth creases.

wrinkles.description: How strongly it wrinkles where a pose bunches it (a seat, a knee, an inner elbow, a waist), 0 to 2, times the character's cloth creases; tight cloth wrinkles a little less than loose.

drape.description: How strongly it gathers in short folds just above its hems and cuffs, 0 to 2, times the character's cloth creases.

eases.description: How far it stands off a covered part along and round it, by part (a pair by its left side), over fit and partFits: keys in order along u, each [u, ease] or [u, front, back] in body units, read as one smooth curve with no steps and flat past the first and last key; the sides take the mean of front and back. A tee tight across the chest and looser at the hem, a sleeve snug at the shoulder and bloused at the forearm, jeans fitted at the hip and flared at the ankle.

hang.description: How the cloth hangs over each upright part it covers (a torso, a leg): from its highest covered place down, straight or flaring out, rather than following the body in; left out, it follows the body.

drops.description: Dropped seams, by part (a sleeve by its left side): how far down the part, in its u, 0 to 0.5, the seam sits where its cloth meets the cloth of the part it grows from; above it the cloth stands off as that part's does, with a pinched, inked seam, as a dropped shoulder.

joins.description: Covered parts whose join with the next covered part is inked. With areas, written from where two areas meet at a part's root instead.

areas.description: The cloth as named areas painted on the body, in order: each area's strokes take cells from the areas before it, so areas never share a cell. Where two areas meet the cloth is one piece with an inked seam (with inkHem). A part an area paints needs no cover.

covers.description: Boxes of cells, one a part: the simple form of cloth, painted into the first area. With areas, a cover on a part they paint only carries its outlines and ease, its range written from the cells. A pair's cover names its left side and covers both.

holes.description: Holes round a part's root: the part and every part beyond it come out through the cloth bare, or ringed by a cuff band.

tucks.description: Whether each small part inside the cloth (an ear, tail, horn, spike or fin it holds whole; the toes or claws at a foot's end it reaches) is tucked under smooth cloth or shaped by it. Left out: toes, claws, tails, horns and spikes tucked, the rest shaped.

changes.description: What it does to body parts under it, by part (a pair by its left side). With areas, a part the cloth says something of takes what the cells say (through where it comes out, hide where it is tucked); a change here holds on every other part.

looseEnds.description: Loose ends it hangs, as a scarf's tails.

regions.description: Regions printed on the cloth, as a chest symbol, a pocket or a stripe: filled shapes in a palette slot, the border inked with ink, given as a part's regions are but naming the body part under the cloth with on, in that part's u and v (or face places on a head, or anchors). They ride the cloth's fit and pose and show only where the cloth is painted, over its areas' colours.

marks.description: Lines printed on the cloth, as stitching or a pocket's outline: given as a part's marks are but naming the body part under the cloth with on; a line only (kind line), its weight along it from width (stops at 0 to 1 along, each a share of the line's weight: 0.4 a thin stitch), its colour from slot. A line shows only where the cloth is painted and ends where it ends.

RecipeGeneric.description: A generic part's own section, views and sampling (tube, blob and sheet only).

section.description: The cross-section profile where Front draws none.

views.description: The views whose outlines shape it: side sets height, top width, front the section. All three when left out.

rings.description: Rings along the part, up to 96: more for a long or detailed part.

segments.description: Control points round each ring, up to 32.

RecipeGlow.description: A glow: the slot's colour whatever the light.

strength.description: How far its middle lifts toward white, 0 to 1.

halo.description: How wide a soft ring it draws round itself, in pixels; none when 0.

RecipeHair.description: Hair made of locks on a head: each lock a separate swept part, in groups (a fringe, the sides, the back, the crown, strays, the top) over an inner mass. A preset gives a whole hairstyle; groups add to it or change its groups by id. docs/reference/hair.md lists every field's range and units and each preset's groups.

on.description: The head the locks grow on, by part id.

mass.description: The inner mass the roots sit on, a hair-volume part on the head, by id; it hides the scalp and lies inside the locks. The head itself when left out.

preset.description: A whole hairstyle: shortSpiky, bob, longStraight, ponytail (tied with a band), sideSwept, curly (round curled locks), buzzCut and fade (a shell cut to the skin), flatTop (a brush cut level over faded sides), undercut (a long top over shaved sides), bluntBob (cut square at the jaw with blunt bangs), braid, twinBraids, bun or spaceBuns.

reach.description: How far the head reaches from its middle, in body units, which a preset's sizes are shares of; read off the built head when left out.

color.description: The locks' palette slot; the mass's base colour, else the head's, when left out.

band.description: The palette slot of a ponytail's band; the locks' colour when left out.

groups.description: Groups of locks: a group whose id a preset gives changes only the fields it sets; any other id adds a group, which needs its kind. Left out or empty, the preset's groups stay as they are.

colliders.description: Whether the body's collision shapes (a sphere in the head, a capsule along the neck, a sphere at each shoulder) are set up from the built body, for a solver to keep hair out of.

flow.description: Which way the hair grows over the scalp: a whorl, a parting, an overall sweep and cowlicks. Each field given replaces the preset's; the preset's flow, else a crown whorl with no parting, when left out.

fitMass.description: An inner mass fitted to the head as built, as the app's preset menu fits one, in place of a mass part of the recipe's own: give this or mass, not both.

outline.description: The hair's drawn outline per view, which with fit the outer locks are fitted to: kit sheet hair traces one from a sheet.

shell.description: Hair cut to the skin over the head: a thin shell inside a hairline, in a stubble tone, fading into the skin up the sides and back. Each field given replaces the preset's shell's; the defaults where the preset has none.

RecipeHairOutline.description: The hair's drawn outline: a closed curve per view round the region the hair covers, its tips and valleys, and whether the hair is fitted to it.

views.description: One outline a view, the front among them; side, three-quarter and back are optional.

fit.description: Whether the build fits the hair to the outline: the outer locks' roots, lengths, rise, sweep, fall and widths so their tips land on its tips and their edges follow it, the inner mass's crown and width to the region it covers, and every other lock kept inside it. The fitted values are the locks' overrides and the mass's parameters.

RecipeHairShell.description: Hair cut to the skin: a thin shell over the scalp inside a hairline, in a stubble tone, fading into the skin up the sides and back.

hairline.description: Where its hairline runs round the head: front, temples, sideburns, ears and nape, each in degrees up the head from level.

thickness.description: How far it stands off the scalp, a share of the head's reach from its middle: about 0.01 a buzz cut.

tone.description: Its palette slot; when left out, a stubble tone: the head's colour carried shade of the way toward the hair's.

shade.description: How far the stubble tone carries the head's colour toward the hair's, 0 bare skin to 1 the hair's own.

soft.description: Degrees over which its edge softens into the skin.

fade.description: How high up the sides and back it fades into the skin: none, low (just above the ears and nape), mid (to the temples) or high (to the corners of the top).

fadeTo.description: How much of its tone is left at the hairline under a fade, 0 bare skin to 1 none faded.

steps.description: How many flat bands a fade steps through from its lowest tone to its whole, each with a crisp edge, as a toon shades (2 to 5, 3 by default); 0 fades smoothly and softens the edge over soft.

RecipeHang.description: How cloth hangs below the highest place it covers on an upright part, rather than following the body in where it narrows.

limit.description: How far past its ease the cloth may stand off the body where it hangs over a narrowing, in body units: about 0.01 to 0.04 on a person-sized body.

flare.description: How far out it falls for each unit it falls down, 0 to 0.5: 0 straight down, 0.1 a slight flare.

RecipeHole.description: A hole round a part's root, as Dress's Hole: the part and every part beyond it come out bare, the cloth's cells on them left out.

part.description: The part that comes out (a pair by its left side, both sides).

cuff.description: Whether a cuff band of the garment's cloth rings the part's root, as a sleeve's or a turtleneck's.

RecipeJoint.description: A hand-made joint, named joint.<n>: the rig makes a bone of it that owns the part from here to the next joint.

n.description: Its number: the joint is named joint.<n>, which poses name.

u.description: Where along the part, 0 at its socket end to 1 at its far end.

hinge.description: The part's axis it turns about: x across the part (a knee or elbow), y about the part's up, z about its length.

low.description: The least it turns, in degrees.

high.description: The most it turns, in degrees.

stretch.description: Whether a stretch handle may move it away from the joint before it.

RecipeKey.description: A pose key: a correction of the body's shape in one pose, blended in by joint angle as a pose nears it and gone at the rest the body is built in. Give an outline redrawn in the key's pose, which the build fits to changes of the parts it touches, or the changes themselves; both, and a part's changes given replace the fitted ones.

name.description: Its name, unique among the keys.

pose.description: The pose it corrects, over the rest: the bones it turns drive it. A pair's bones on one side drive that side's half of the body; a pose naming one side only drives the other through the twin bones.

outline.description: The figure outline redrawn in the key's pose: only the strokes that change, few points, smooth. Read in each limb's own bones as posed, and fitted to changes of the tube parts' widths and of the blends where they join.

changes.description: Changes of the parts' widths and joins, read over the parts' own settings, so an edit of the rest keeps them.

RecipeKeyChange.description: What a key changes on one part, read over its own settings.

part.description: The part: a pair by its id changes both sides.

widths.description: Width scales by direction: forward (or front), back, up, down, left, right, outer or inner as a tube's profiles name them, or side+, side-, top+ and top- for a side of the part's Side or Top outline. Each is a run of [x, scale] places along the part, eased between them and held level past its ends.

blend.description: How much the blend where it joins its parent is scaled by; a part with no blend of its own scales the blend the build gives its join.

RecipeKeyLight.description: The way to a key light in body space: x forward, y up, z to the character's right; any length but zero.

RecipeKeyOutline.description: A figure outline redrawn in a key's pose: strokes as a figure's, in body units standing on the ground, only where the key changes the body.

front.description: The front view: the character's left half, x from the body's middle toward its left, y up from the ground. Each stroke runs with the figure on its right.

side.description: The side view from the character's left: x forward from the body's middle, y up from the ground.

rootHeight.description: How high above the ground the root part's origin sits, in body units; the figure's when left out.

rounds.description: Rounds of correction on the keyed body's silhouette. 4 when left out.

joins.description: Whether the blends where the parts it reaches join are fitted to it too. On when left out.

RecipeLandmark.description: A hand-made landmark, named landmark.<n>: a named surface point mark groups anchor to.

RecipeLineWeight.description: Heavier lines within radius of a stretch of the part.

points.description: The stretch as [u, v] on the part.

radius.description: How far it reaches, a share of the part's length.

amount.description: How much heavier: a line's weight times 1 plus this.

RecipeLockGroup.description: A group of locks. Every field but id is optional: a preset's group of the same id keeps what this leaves out; a new group needs its kind.

id.description: The group's id; a preset's groups are back, left, right, crown, top, fringe, strays and tail, which of them each preset gives in docs/reference/hair.md.

kind.description: Where it roots: fringe, left, right, back, crown, strays or top. Needed for a group the preset does not give.

spread.description: How far round the head its roots reach, a share of its kind's own reach (a fringe's about 96 degrees across the front, a side's about 66, the back's about 116): 1 the kind's own, 0 all at its middle.

around.description: Degrees its roots turn round the head, positive toward the character's right.

height.description: How far up the head its roots move, -1 to 1 of about 20 degrees (15 for a crown, strays and the top, whose height moves it forward).

length.description: Each lock's length, in body units.

lengthJitter.description: How far lengths vary either way, a share of the length.

width.description: Each lock's width at its root, in body units.

thickness.description: Each lock's thickness at its root, in body units.

taper.description: What share of its root width a lock keeps toward its tip.

section.description: ribbon, a flattened lock cupped round the head (smooth, straight or wavy hair, a bob, long hair), clump, a rounded one (spiky, short or curly hair, tufts), or braid, three strands plaited along the lock to a tie with a short loose tail; a tied group of one braid lock is a braid.

tip.description: pointed (spikes, ragged ends), round (a bob's blunt ends, curls), forked into 2 or 3 points (a choppy, layered fringe) or flicked, turning out 50 degrees at its end (a flicked fringe or hem).

tipPoints.description: How many points a forked tip ends in.

rise.description: Degrees each lock's outer part lifts off the head, past about half its length; it lies along the head from its root: 0 lies flat all along, 90 stands its end straight out. Over about 30 short locks read as spikes. A tied lock leaves its tie at this angle.

sweep.description: How far the locks sweep sideways as they grow, over the way the scalp's flow grows them, -1 to 1: 1 turns a lock 70 degrees round over its length toward the character's right.

fall.description: How far the locks fall toward the ground along their length, 0 none to 1 hanging.

curl.description: How many turns each lock curls toward its underside; negative the other way.

wave.description: How far each lock waves sideways, a share of its width.

twist.description: How far each lock turns about itself over its length, in degrees.

seed.description: Which picks the jitter: another seed, another layout with the same look.

layer.description: Its layer: locks of a higher layer lie over those of a lower one.

tie.description: How far its roots gather toward one point, 0 spread to 1 all at one tie.

band.description: The palette slot of a band round the tie.

color.description: Its palette slot, over the hair's.

physics.description: How its locks move once physics drives them: stiffness, damping, weight, gravity, wind, angleLimit, neighbours.

flow.description: How far its locks grow the way the scalp's flow says, 0 its kind's own way (down the head; a crown's swirling out from its middle) to 1 the flow's.

lie.description: How much of each lock's length lies along the head before it lifts off by its rise, 0.05 to 0.95: low stands it out from near its root, a brush or a flat top.

stand.description: How far each lock turns from the way it grows toward straight up from its root, 0 following the head to 1 standing straight up: a brush, a flat top.

trim.description: A plane its lock tips are cut to, for blunt ends and flat tops: level (a share of the head's reach above the skull's middle, negative toward the jaw), tilt (degrees, positive stands its front higher) and blunt (whether a cut lock ends square).

coil.description: With tie, how many turns each lock coils round the tie into a bun: about 1.5 a bun; 0 hangs free.

locks.description: Single locks set by hand, by index: any field given replaces the group's for that lock, guide gives it a curve of its own, hidden leaves it out.

removed.description: Leaves out a preset's group of this id.

RecipeMark.description: A mark: an ink line through its places, or a fur stroke from its one root. Give its places one way: points, face or anchors.

points.description: Its places as [u, v] on the part.

face.description: On a head: its places as [x, y] on the face seen from straight ahead.

anchors.description: Its places as anchors, each naming its part.

width.description: How its weight runs along it: stops at 0 to 1 along, each a share of the line's weight.

ink.description: Whether it is inked; a mark a group fills may be left un-inked.

slot.description: Its colour; the ink's when left out.

mirrored.description: On a part in the middle of the body: also shown mirrored on the other side. In a garment's marks, on a pair's side too: shown on its other side.

cameraLocked.description: Whether it sits where the light and camera put it rather than on the surface.

versions.description: Its shape in named camera bins (front, three-quarter, side), replacing its places there.

flight.description: For a floating mark: the places it passes through off the surface after its root, each {along, across, out} in body units from the root: along the way the part's u grows, across the way its v grows, out along the surface's normal.

on.description: In a garment's marks only: the body part its places lie on, as the cloth over it prints them (a pair's side by its own id). Left out with anchors.

RecipeMassFit.description: An inner mass fitted to the head as built: a hair-volume cap with no strands, sized by the head's box, its top following the skull's dome, its front above the brow and its hem cut into points.

id.description: Its part id; the head's id with -hair when left out.

color.description: Its palette slot; the palette's hair slot, else the head's colour, when left out.

params.description: hair-volume parameters over the fitted ones (templates.md, hair-volume): width, back, sides, fringe, rise, crown, locks, lockDepth, lockJag and the rest. Most heads need none.

RecipeMaterial.description: A palette slot's toon material: a preset, and any setting changed from it. Written as the preset's name alone where nothing changes.

preset.description: The finish it starts from: matte (two tones, the default), skin, cloth, plastic (a sharp round spot), metal (three hard tones, a band and a bright rim), glass (see-through with a streak) or glow (its colour whatever the light, with a halo).

steps.description: How many flat tones it shades in, 1 to 3: 1 flat, 2 lit and shadow, 3 lit, a middle tone and shadow.

shadow.description: Its own shadow tone; when left out, the shadow slot's colour, else its colour shifted darker.

shadowSlot.description: A palette slot whose colour is its shadow tone.

shadowDepth.description: How much darker its shifted shadow is, 0 to 1; the character's own depth when left out.

shadowShift.description: Which way its shifted shadow turns: auto (warm for a saturated colour, cool for a pale one), cool or warm.

rim.description: A light edge along the silhouette.

shine.description: A shine from the key light: a spot, a band or a streak.

seeThrough.description: How much of what lies behind a part or cloth in it the part hides, 0 to 1, more toward the silhouette on cloth: a lens at 0.35 shows the eyes through it. Whole when left out. On a separate part it holds for its base colour, drawn after everything whole; on cloth it multiplies each area's own.

glow.description: A glow: its colour whatever the light, its middle lifted toward white, with a halo round it.

RecipeMembrane.description: A thin sheet of skin spanned between parts: a patagium from wrist to ankle, a wing from arm and finger to flank. It rides the bones of the parts it is anchored to and inks only its free edge. Webs between the digits of one hand or foot are its template's webbing parameters instead.

first.description: The first rail: edges in order from the membrane's root to where its free edge meets this side.

second.description: The second rail, the same way. The free edge runs between the two rails' ends.

edge.description: How far the free edge curves in between the rails' ends, a share of their reach: 0 straight.

billow.description: How far its middle billows off the plane between its rails, a share of the gap between them: toward the ground where it lies level, out from the body where it hangs beside it; negative the other way.

thickness.description: How thick it is half way between its rails, a share of how deep its rails sit in their parts.

sink.description: How deep into its parts its rails sit: 0 on their surface, 1 on their middle.

color.description: Its palette slot; the base colour of the part its first rail starts on when left out.

mirrored.description: Whether it is built again on the other side: each part of a pair named by its left id is read as its right twin there, and v is mirrored on a part in the middle.

RecipeMembraneEdge.description: A stretch of a part's surface a membrane is anchored along, from [u, v] to [u, v]; a socket point where the two are the same.

part.description: The part, by id; a pair by its left side's id.

from.description: [u, v] where the edge starts: u along the part from its socket end, v round it (0 top, 0.25 left, 0.5 underside, 0.75 right).

to.description: [u, v] where the edge ends; the same as from for a point.

patch.description: The run of the part it lies on, such as a digit (fingers:2); the part's first run reaching each u when left out.

RecipeNet.description: A net of threads laid on the body under the cloth, stretching with it in every pose; too fine to draw, it reads as an even tone.

pattern.description: How the two sets of threads cross: diamond, both slanting from the part's length by angle, one each way, as fishnets; square, one along the part turned by angle and one square to it.

hole.description: The spacing between threads, in body units: about 0.02 to 0.04 for fishnets on a person-sized body.

thread.description: How wide a thread is, in body units, under the hole.

angle.description: In degrees, 0 to 90: a diamond net's threads' slant from the part's length, 45 for square diamonds, less for taller ones; a square net's turn from along and round.

RecipeOutline.description: A drawn outline: a few [x, y] places it passes through (smooth, with corners where named), or the cubic Bézier points themselves. x runs along the part from its socket end; y is across.

through.description: Places the outline passes through, [x, y] each. Few points: 6 to 14 for a body, 3 to 8 for a limb.

corners.description: Indices into through that are sharp corners, as an ear's tip.

closed.description: Whether through closes back to its first place, as a torso or head drawn all round does; an open outline runs from one side of the axis to the other.

bezier.description: The Bézier points [x, y] themselves: a start point, then two handles and an end point per segment (3n + 1 points). In place of through.

RecipeOutlineView.description: The hair's outline in one view.

view.description: front, three-quarter (the camera 45 degrees round toward the character's left), side (the camera on the character's left) or back.

points.description: The closed curve round the region the hair covers as the view sees it, each [x, y]: x to the view's right and y up, in the head's drawn units from its origin, the frame face places use seen from the view's camera. 3 to 600 points.

tips.description: The points of its spikes and flicks, by index into points; found from the curve's shape when left out (a turn of 50 degrees or more out of the region within 2% of its length round).

valleys.description: The notches between them, by index into points; found from the curve's shape when left out (a turn of 35 degrees or more into the region).

heads.description: Whether the points are in the sheet head's lengths (its chin to its crown in this view is 1, from its chin), as kit sheet hair reads them, rather than the head's drawn units: the build sizes them to the head as built, by its eye line where the front view gives eyes and the head has painted eyes, else by its height.

eyes.description: How high the sheet's eye line stands over its chin in this view, in head lengths: on the front view, what sizes an outline given in heads.

RecipePair.description: The ids of a pair's two sides; <id>-l and <id>-r when left out.

RecipePart.description: A part, or with pair a mirrored pair described once as its left side.

id.description: The part's id; for a pair, the pair's id, its sides' ids under pair.

template.description: The template it is built from: torso, head, head-round, leg, arm, paw, hand, foot, tail, ear, tube, blob, sheet and so on.

version.description: The template's version; the newest shipped when left out.

on.description: The part it sits on; a pair on a pair sits each side on its own side. Left out for the root part.

socket.description: The socket on that part: one of its template's or plan's sockets, or a hand-made socket.<n> it declares under sockets.

pair.description: Makes this a mirrored pair: its left and right parts' ids.

role.description: What the part is to the body; its template's role, or guessed from where it sits, when left out.

garment.description: The garment that owns this part: it is built only while that garment is worn, as a heel, lens or buckle is.

blend.description: How far the smooth join with the part it sits on reaches, in body units. Left out, a part that starts open (a limb, a neck, a tail) rounds in by 1.4 times its root radius, held back where it runs close beside the part it sits on; any other takes its template's join or a quarter of its least extent. Off a template join it fills the crease where the two surfaces meet at an angle and leaves them as they are where they run alongside each other.

bind.description: For a part a garment owns, which bones it moves with: single rides the one bone it sits on, rigid, as a heel, buckle or button; follow takes the bones of the body under it, weighted as the body's skin is there, so a boot shaft, knee band or shell round a limb bends with the joint it crosses and keeps its stand-off from the body in a pose. Left out, a part that goes round the limb under it and crosses a joint there follows, and any other rides one bone.

stiff.description: For a part a garment owns that follows the body, how rigid it keeps each stretch between joints, 0 to 1: 0 bends as the skin under it bends, more gathers the bend toward the joint, as a stiff boot shaft does, and 1 keeps each vertex on its heaviest bone alone. 0 when left out.

size.description: Scales the drawn part: its length and width together.

lean.description: Degrees the part leans toward its own up (move.lean), less than 90 either way; with outward, a turn of the rest toward a corner.

outward.description: Degrees the part leans out from the body's middle plane, mirrored on the right (move.outward), less than 90 either way; an A-pose arm takes 45.

outlines.description: Outlines by view. Side sets height (a profile), Top sets width, Front the cross-section from -1 to 1 where the template says.

tube.description: A tube part's widths as curves along its bone, in place of its Side and Top outlines: they are built into them as drawn.

rest.description: The direction the part rests in, in place of its template's (move.rest): a generic root resting up is a standing body.

roll.description: Degrees the part rolls about its own axis, turning its up toward its v 0.25 side, after rest, lean and outward (move.roll): a sheet resting out and rolled 90 faces forward.

topMiddle.description: Whether Top's midline moves the part's middle sideways along its length, as Side's moves it up and down: a band or lens drawn curved in Top wraps round what it sits on (top.middle). Top sets width alone when left out.

generic.description: A generic part's section, views and sampling (generic.*).

sockets.description: Hand-made sockets on this part, for parts to sit on (socket.<n>.*).

joints.description: Hand-made joints on this part, each a bone poses name joint.<n> (joint.<n>.*).

jointsAt.description: The template's own joints moved along the part, by name, to a u (move.joint.<name>).

socketsAt.description: Sockets this part offers moved, by name, to [u, v] or [u, v, sink] for both sides (move.socket.<name>.u, .v and .sink): the sink is how deep a part on it sits, times that part's own sink, 0 to 4, and is the socket's own when left out.

curve.description: Places the part's axis curves through after its socket point, as [along, up] or [along, up, side] in the part's own axes as fractions of its length (curve.<n>.*): along its rest direction, toward its top (Side's +y), toward its side at v 0.25. 2 to 24 places, which may turn back on themselves and leave the plane; the smooth curve through them is scaled to the part's length, so they set its shape and size its reach. Taken by every template that sweeps along its axis (templates.md says which); replaces a template's curve (tail-curve) or curves a straight part. Undrawn, thickness or girth and taper set its radius along it; drawn, its outlines give its width along the length and the curve its path. A bend tighter than the part is thick narrows it there, with a warning. An S with a hooked end: [[0.25, -0.12], [0.5, 0.08], [0.72, -0.05], [0.88, 0.1], [0.86, 0.22], [0.76, 0.24]].

spiral.description: A spiral the axis coils in, in place of curve places (curve.spiral.*).

inkJoin.description: Whether the join where this part sits on its parent is inked as a line round it (join.ink); inked when left out.

preset.description: A preset of its template's (templates.md lists them): its parameter values, which params and the fields above override, as a bob for a hair volume.

params.description: Template parameters by name, as toes, merge or claw, and any dotted part parameter the fields above do not name.

color.description: The palette slot the whole part is coloured.

shades.description: Palette slots its copies pick among besides color, where it sits on a socket with spread or path: two or three shades of a fleece.

areas.description: Areas the template names, as a nail or a pad, each filled with a palette slot.

regions.description: Painted regions on the part, each in a palette slot: a muzzle, a chest patch, a two-tone face.

marks.description: Ink lines and fur strokes on the part.

groups.description: Mark groups, as a mouth: roles in draw order, each naming marks above.

fur.description: How the part's fur strokes show, and patches of fur stroke roots laid in rows.

lineWeights.description: Heavier lines along a stretch of the part.

RecipeParting.description: A parting: none, centre or side; where across the top; how far back; how clean; the scalp's colour along it.

at.description: How far across the top it runs, -1 to 1 of the most a part sits off the middle (about over the outer corner of the eye): positive toward the character's right.

length.description: How far back from the hairline it runs: 1 reaches the crown.

clean.description: How clean the split is, 0 a soft, wandering split to 1 a sharp, straight line.

color.description: The palette slot of the scalp along it; when left out, a scalp tone: the head's colour darkened toward the hair's.

RecipePath.description: Copies of the part on a socket repeated along a path on its part, its axis along the surface's normal and its up along the path: beads, studs, a row of buttons, chain links.

count.description: How many copies, evenly from end to end; as many as pitch fits when left out.

pitch.description: The distance between copies, in body units; a ring part's links its inside length when neither count nor pitch is given, so each passes through the next.

via.description: Places [u, v] on the part the path runs through between its ends.

between.description: Two sockets this part offers, by name, the path's ends in place of (u, v) and (to, toV): a hand-made socket.<n> listed here, or one of its template's.

roll.description: Degrees each copy rolls about the path more than the one before it: 90 turns every other chain link.

sag.description: How far the path droops at its middle, in body units, as a chain hangs between its two ends; it lies on the part where the droop would take it inside.

RecipeRegion.description: A painted region. Give its border one way: border ([u, v] on the part), face ([x, y] on a head's face seen from ahead) or anchors. The border is a smooth closed curve through its places, so a few places make a round shape; corners makes some sharp, and curved: false runs it straight between them. Two regions whose borders pass through the same places meet along one shared edge with no gap and no overlap, sharp where the borders part: draw a two-tone face as a light region and a dark one sharing the places of their boundary.

slot.description: The palette slot it is painted in.

ink.description: Whether its border is inked as a line.

patch.description: The patch its border's u, v lie on: body, or a patch the template names, as muzzle.

border.description: The border as [u, v] on the part: u along it from its socket end, v round it.

face.description: On a head: the border as [x, y] on the face seen from straight ahead, x to the character's left (negative for the right), y up, in the head's drawn units from its socket.

anchors.description: The border as anchors, each naming its part; for a region that runs across parts.

corners.description: Indices into the border's places that are sharp corners, as a chin's point.

curved.description: Whether the border is the smooth curve through its places on a part joined into the body's one surface, as a head on a neck; false runs it straight between them there.

mirrored.description: On a part in the middle of the body (a torso, a head): also shown mirrored on the other side, at 1 - v. In a garment's regions, on a pair's side too: shown on its other side.

on.description: In a garment's regions only: the body part its border's places lie on, as the cloth over it prints them (a pair's side by its own id). Left out with anchors.

RecipeRim.description: A light edge along the silhouette.

width.description: How far in from the silhouette it reaches on the side turned from the light, 0 to 1, as a share of the way to the middle of a round form.

color.description: Its colour; the slot's colour lifted toward white when left out.

RecipeScalpFlow.description: Which way hair grows over the scalp. Every lock root takes its direction from it unless its group's flow is under 1. Each field given replaces the preset's.

whorl.description: The crown point hair spirals out from: around (degrees from the front toward the character's right, 180 the back), up (degrees from level, 90 the top), turn (-1 to 1, positive clockwise seen from above), strength (0 to 2) and radius (degrees across the head).

part.description: A line where hair splits and lies away to each side, the scalp showing along it as a thin line.

sweep.description: An overall comb toward one side, -1 to 1: positive toward the character's right; strongest over the top.

sweepBack.description: An overall comb back over the top, -1 to 1: positive toward the back, negative forward.

cowlicks.description: Small local swirls or flips, at most 8: around and up place each as a whorl's; radius in degrees; strength 0 to 2; turn 0 flips the hair back against the flow, 1 or -1 swirls it; lift in degrees raises the locks over it.

mode.description: flat, one colour a part; or twoTone, a lit and a shadow colour with a hard edge. Renders are always two-tone.

farSideDarker.description: Whether the side of a pair away from the camera darkens.

farSide.description: How much darker the far side is, as a share of its colour, 0 to 0.5: raise it where the sheet sets far legs and the far ear clearly darker.

light.description: view: the light turns with the camera, from in front of the viewer, above and to their left, so a back view is lit as the front is; body: fixed in front of the character, so a back view falls in shade.

key.description: The shot's key light, fixed to the body: a surface is lit where it or the light above reaches, and materials' spots, bands and streaks come from it, so they stay toward it as the camera turns. From the light above when left out.

RecipeShape.description: A part's shape and colour as a garment lays it over the part.

RecipeShine.description: A shine from the key light, where the surface faces halfway between the light and the viewer.

shape.description: Its shape: none, spot (small, sharp and round), band (broad and hard, with a darker reflection beside it) or streak (thin, across the light's way).

color.description: Its colour; near white in the slot's hue when left out.

slot.description: The name parts, regions and garments use for it.

color.description: The colour: "#rrggbb", or [red, green, blue] from 0 to 1.

label.description: What the app calls it; the slot's name when left out.

material.description: Its toon material, which anything painted in it takes: a preset's name ("metal"), or an object with a preset and the settings it changes. Matte when left out.

n.description: Its number: the socket is named socket.<n>.

u.description: Where along the part, 0 at its socket end to 1 at its far end.

v.description: Where round the part, as the left side reads it: on an upright part 0 faces forward, 0.25 her right, 0.5 back, 0.75 her left.

outward.description: Degrees its outward direction turns from the surface's normal toward the part's end.

mirrored.description: Whether it has a mirrored twin across the body's middle, for a pair to sit on.

sink.description: How deep a part sits in here, as a multiple of that part's own sink, 0 or more: 0 seats it on the surface; once when left out.

outset.description: How far a part on it stands off the surface along its normal, in body units, before it sinks: a pocket or button on a shirt of fit 0.012 takes a little more than 0.012 with sink 0. 0 when left out.

reach.description: How far from the part's axis, in body units, the root of a part on it sits, toward v at u: the part's root lies there however wide this part is drawn, in place of on the surface sunk by sink. A part on a figure takes it from the fit when left out.

count.description: Makes it a row of this many sockets (2 to 16), evenly from u to `to` along the part and from v to toV round it, named socket.<n>.0, socket.<n>.1 and on, a part on each. Many of one part over an area or along a line take spread or path instead.

to.description: A row's last socket's u; the row's u when left out.

toV.description: A row's last socket's v; the row's v when left out. A whole turn from v (v 0, toV 1) closes the row round the part, its sockets evenly a turn's share apart, as studs round a belt.

size.description: The size a part placed on a row's first socket starts at, when the part gives no size of its own; with spread or path, each copy's size, times the part's own.

falloff.description: The size a part placed on a row's last socket starts at, as a share of the first's; with spread, the share of their size copies fall to at the area's edges.

patch.description: The digit patch its u and v lie on, so it rides that digit: fingers:2 on a hand, fingers:thumb, toes:0 on a foot or paw. The part's first run reaching u when left out, which on a hand past the palm is fingers:0.

spread.description: Makes it one socket showing many copies of the one part on it, scattered over the area from u to `to` along the part and v to toV round it: v 0 and toV 1 runs all round it.

path.description: Makes it one socket showing copies of the one part on it repeated along a path from (u, v) through its via places to (to, toV), or between two sockets.

RecipeSpiral.description: A spiral the part's axis coils in from its socket point, in place of curve places: a ram's horn, a coiled trunk or tail.

turns.description: How many times it coils, up to 4: positive curls toward the part's top (Side's +y), negative toward its underside (curve.spiral.turns).

pitch.description: How far the coil moves toward the part's side at v 0.25 each turn, as a share of its first coil's diameter; negative the other way; 0 a flat coil (curve.spiral.pitch).

shrink.description: The coil's radius at the tip as a share of its radius at the root: below 1 it tightens toward the tip (curve.spiral.shrink).

RecipeSpread.description: Copies of the part on a socket scattered over its area, each an instance of the one part: edit the part and every copy changes.

count.description: How many copies, 1 to 1000; fewer show where spacing leaves no room for more.

seed.description: Picks the places and jitter; another seed, another scatter.

spacing.description: The least distance between two copies, in body units, so they do not pile up. None when left out.

sizeJitter.description: How far each copy's size varies either way, as a share of it: 0.2 is 80% to 120%.

leanJitter.description: The most degrees a copy leans from the surface's normal, each a random way.

turnJitter.description: The most degrees a copy turns about itself either way.

edge.description: The outer share of the area over which copies' size falls to the socket's falloff, 0.35 when left out.

droop.description: Degrees each copy tilts from the surface's normal toward the body's down along the surface, its up turned to the normal, so hair clumps lie down over a head; 60 to 80 for a fall of hair, none when left out.

rows.description: Lays the copies in this many rows evenly along the area, count of them evenly round each, in place of a scatter: plates, scales, shingles. With outward near 90 each lies back along the part toward its end, over the root of the next row.

stagger.description: How far round every other row is shifted, as a share of the gap between two copies in a row, where the copies lie in rows; 0.5 when left out, as bricks lie.

RecipeStroke.description: One Paint stroke on a part, as Dress lays it: the cells of the part's chart (64 rows along it in u, 32 columns round it in v) whose middles the shape holds. A cell is 1/64 of u by 1/32 of v; the cloth's edge is a smooth curve over the cells' edges, and an area under two cells wide drops out, unless its strokes are exact. brush: every cell within size of the path through points (or face), straight between them in u and v; one place is a dab. line: every cell within size of the straight lines in the body between its places. A brush or line reaches the parts beyond its part (from a sleeve onto the hand), never the parts it sits on. band: rows u[0] to u[1] the whole way round. box: u[0] to u[1] along and v[0] to v[1] round. ellipse: the ellipse inside that box. lasso: inside the closed polygon through points (or face), straight between them in u and v, or a smooth curve through them when curved. opening: the cells round where the part on comes out (a neck, an arm, an ear) within reach past its root ring, on every part but those beyond it, its front dropping depth below the ring in its cut: unpaint one for a crew or V neckline, paint a wider one and unpaint a narrower for a collar band round it.

on.description: The part painted on (a pair by either side: both sides take it, mirrored).

shape.description: brush, line, band, box, ellipse, lasso or opening.

unpaint.description: Takes the cells from every area instead of painting them, as Alt in Dress.

u.description: band, box, ellipse: [from, to] along the part, 0 at its root to 1 at its far end.

v.description: box, ellipse: [from, to] round the part; from may lie below 0 to cross v 0. The whole way round when left out.

points.description: brush, line, lasso: the places as [u, v] on the part.

face.description: brush, line, lasso on a head: the places as [x, y] on its face seen from straight ahead, as a region's face.

size.description: brush, line: how far from the path a cell's middle may lie and be painted, in body units, as Dress's Size.

mirrored.description: On a part in the body's middle (a torso, a head): also painted mirrored across the middle, at -v, as Dress's Mirror.

clean.description: Clean edges, 0 to 1: up to four rounds of smoothing the area's edge within two cells of the stroke, each cell taking what most of it and its neighbours are.

cut.description: opening: round, a crew or scoop neck's curve, or v, two straight sides to a point.

reach.description: opening: how far past the root ring of the part on it reaches all round, in body units.

depth.description: opening: how far its front drops below the ring at its middle, in body units; 0 is a plain ring.

exact.description: band, box, ellipse, lasso: the stroke is kept as a vector shape, and the cloth's edge is the shapes' outline itself rather than a smooth curve over the cells, however narrow: a tie, a collar's points, a strap, a bikini's cups, cut crisp and with no area dropping out. Where a stroke that is not exact (an opening, a brush) takes or adds cells, the edge there is the cells'. It paints every cell within half a cell of it and unpaints those more than half a cell inside it; a box or band reaching within half a row of an end of its part runs on over that end. A stroke on a pair names the side the pair is kept on; clean is 0.

curved.description: An exact lasso: one smooth curve through its places rather than straight between them, turning sharply at corners.

corners.description: An exact lasso with curved: the indices of the places where the curve turns sharply, as a tie's tip or a collar's point.

RecipeTarget.description: A proportion the built character should have.

name.description: What is measured: handLength, handWidth, footLength, footWidth, headHeight, headWidth, eyeLine, eyeWidth, eyeSpacing.

of.description: What the value is a share of: head, the head's height; or height, the figure's height from the ground to the top of the head. For a place (eyeLine) head is its depth down the head from the crown and height its height above the ground.

tolerance.description: How far off it may be before it is flagged: a share of the value for a size (0.15 when left out), a share of the head for a place (0.05 when left out).

RecipeTube.description: A tube part's widths as curves along its bone, one a direction: x along the part from its socket end, y its radius that way. They become its Side and Top outlines as drawn, rounded to the axis at its length (and at 0 when closed). On a figure, the fit draws the profiles it leaves out.

length.description: Its length along its bone: outline x runs 0 to this.

profiles.description: Radius curves by direction: forward (or front), back, up, down, left and right; a pair's left side may name outer (its left) and inner (its right). Its rest decides which two Side takes and which two Top takes (frames.md); a Top direction left out mirrors the other. Each is an open curve through a few [x, r] places, smooth but at its corners, or its Bézier points.

closed.description: Rounded at its socket end too, as a torso or head drawn all round is; open there when left out, as a limb is.

flat.description: Ends square at its length rather than rounding over: a sleeve's cut end.

RecipeTuck.description: A Tuck choice: a small part inside the cloth tucked under smooth cloth (hidden) or shaped (the cloth follows it).

part.description: The part (a pair by its left side): the small part itself, or the foot or hand whose toes or claws it means.

kind.description: toes, claws, fingers, ears, tail, horns, spikes or fins.

tucked.description: Tucked under smooth cloth (true) or shaped (false).

RecipeWardrobe.description: Clothes: slots (places on the body an outfit fills once), garments and outfits.

slots.description: Places on the body, as top, bottom, feet, head; each outfit picks at most one garment a slot.

outfits.description: Named sets of garments: picks map a slot to a garment in it.

shown.description: The outfit the character is saved wearing; bare when left out.

Redraw.description: The part keeps its template and takes this shape over its own: outlines and parameters by name, regions by id.

Swap.description: The part takes another template with this shape while the garment is worn, as a closed shoe swaps a foot for a blob.

Through.description: The part comes out through a hole: an armhole or neckline with cuff false, a collar or sleeve cuff with cuff true.

cuffSize.description: How far the cuff reaches past the hole, a share of the part's length.

ToothRow.description: A row of slots from the middle outward, mirrored to the other side unless a slot says otherwise.

ToothSlot.description: One place in a row, from the middle outward: a tooth type, how far it sits from the slot before it, and any of the type's settings changed here.

type.description: The tooth type by name, from the preset's `types`.

gap.description: Space before this slot, after the one nearer the middle, or from the middle for the first; a share of the mouth's width.

at.description: Where the slot's middle sits along the row, its distance from the mouth's middle as a share of the mouth's width, in place of following the slot before it.

width.description: The type's width, changed for this slot.

length.description: The type's length, changed for this slot.

curve.description: The type's curve, changed for this slot.

tip.description: The type's tip, changed for this slot.

over.description: Whether it shows over the lips, open or shut, breaking their ink: incisors, fangs, a crocodile's lower teeth.

side.description: Which sides it fills: both, mirrored, unless left or right.

ToothSlotChange.description: A change to one slot, by row and slot index: each value set replaces the slot's; removed takes it out.

ViewKey.description: A head cheat at one view: what it moves there.

view.description: The view: front, three-quarter, side, three-quarter-back or back, by where the camera sits round the head's own facing.

side.description: The camera's side of the head this key holds for: left or right. Left out, the key is for the left and Squash mirrors it for the right; the front and back take none.

ViewKeys.description: Head cheats that follow the camera: what each view moves on the head, blended between neighbouring views as the camera turns round the head's own facing.

auto.description: Whether every head's default keys apply: its muzzle leans toward the camera and its ears turn toward profile. On when left out.

keys.description: Keys per view, each move replacing the default for the same thing at that view.

face.description: How the face meets a turning camera: turning (the face slides part way round toward the camera and the head's shape changes from view to view) or fixed (the head keeps one shape from the front round to the side and the face stays turned to the viewer). The head template's when left out.

faceFollow.description: How far the face's features (eyes, brows, nose, mouth, muzzle, cheek marks) slide round the head toward the camera, from 0 (fixed on the head) to 1 (centred on the viewer up to the side view). Past the side view they slide back and hide behind the head. The face style's when left out.

keepFace.description: Whether the face slides as one piece and keeps its features' size, rather than gathering toward the far side as it turns. The face style's when left out.

Whorl.description: The crown point hair spirals out from.

around.description: Degrees round the head from the front, positive toward the character's right: 180 is the back.

up.description: Degrees up the head from level: 90 is the top.

turn.description: How far hair turns round the whorl as it leaves it, -1 to 1: positive clockwise seen from above, 0 straight out.

strength.description: How strongly it rules the hair round it, 0 not at all to 2.

radius.description: How far across the head it reaches, in degrees.
